slides.title: The one I regret selling: my 60 Series.
slides.body: Two LJs, an 80, an FJ Cruiser, four 4Runners and now a G 500. The 60 is the one I miss. Here's what to know if you go looking for one.

slides.title: Slow, thirsty and wonderful.
slides.body: A carbureted 2F, a four-speed, leaf springs and round headlights. A Land Cruiser that carries a family and a cooler and is still a truck.

slides.title: Rear frame rails decide it.
slides.body: Drop the spare and look at the rear rails. If the frame is rusted through, walk away. Then the windshield corners, drip rails and the floor under the rear seat.

slides.title: Rust sets the price.
slides.body: 100 Bring a Trailer sales since Jan 2025: projects $3k–13k, drivers $20k–40k, the best $57k–85k. Median about $29,100.

end.title: Which one do you regret selling?
end.body: The full 60 Series guide: years, the checks, the repairs and what they're worth.
